subject: Request: Trial Credit Allocation for FedHealth VPC Pilot — SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@fedhealth.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@fedhealth.io, tom.li@fedhealth.io
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Trial Credit Allocation for FedHealth VPC Pilot — SOC2 evidence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week. We are preparing a 90-day isolated VPC pilot to validate inference performance and data residency controls for an upcoming procurement cycle. Procurement would like confirmation of two things before we spin up: 1) a promotional credit allocation to cover GPU runtime during the pilot (ballpark $12k–$18k), and 2) a short list of security/compliance artifacts Redwood can provide up front (SOC2 summary, pen test confirmation, network isolation checklist).

I've attached our internal request form (FedHealth-vpc-request-form.pdf) — please review and let us know what evidence you can provide and whether Redwood can commit credits for the pilot. We have an internal review scheduled for 2028-06-15, so an answer this week would help procurement.

Best,
Ellen Price
Head of Cloud Integrations
FedHealth

---
Attachment: FedHealth-vpc-request-form.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Trial Credit Allocation for FedHealth VPC Pilot — SOC2 evidence

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the form. Looping in Ben (SE) and Grace (acct lead) so we can scope the pilot and compile the evidence pack.

Quick summary of what we can offer immediately:
- Trial credits: we can provision a one-time promotional allocation for an isolated VPC pilot. Pending internal approvals, typical grants for pilots like this range from $8k–$15k depending on scope.
- Evidence: we can provide our SOC2 Type II summary, an internal pen-test attestation for the serving runtime, and a redacted network isolation checklist. Ben will attach what he can share today.

Action items:
1) Ben — can you attach the SOC2 summary and any redacted infra notes that are safe to share?
2) Grace — please confirm the target throughput and estimated GPU hours so I can request a specific credit amount from Sales Ops (cc Laura).
3) Ellen — any constraints on third-party reviewers or an NDA requirement?

If Sales Ops approves, we will: (a) allocate a 90-day credit grant tied to Deal HSP-7892, (b) create a VPC trial config, and (c) send a DocuSign for the pilot terms.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Sales, Redwood Inference
